title: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic tagine made with lamb, inspired by Moroccan cuisine. This dish is perfect for a cold winter evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the lamb pieces in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the olives, yogurt, and 1 cup of water. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Let the tagine rest for 10 minutes before serving.
